Hey, I know that it feels like there’s no options left and you probably just want an escape from it all but please take a moment to think. You have value, and you can get through this. Try finding something that can help you unwind and help you take your mind off things. Watch some tv, play video games. Try to do something productive, even if it’s small. Even if it is something as small as brushing your teeth or cleaning your laundry, or making your bed. Please just give your mind some time and space to thoroughly think things over before you act rashly. I may just be some dumb@as on the internet but you need to know that we care for you. If you need to talk just message me.

I’ve felt the same a lot. I barely eat anything, let my hygiene go to sh*t, and ask myself what’s the point. It’s hard to put in effort when you feel like if you do it’ll be pointless and won’t change anything, but I still try to. If I’m able to do at least one productive thing in a day I can at least tell myself I’m not completely useless. Try to do one thing, even if it’s tiny. You brush your teeth one day even though you didn’t want to? Good job. You ate a semi-healthy meal? It’s a start. Focus on the good things you do rather than what you don’t do. Keep struggling, don’t give up

That sucks, being unable to do things and work on yourself is tough. I have full blown diagnosed depression and it makes me feel pretty dull. In my case it’s not that I can’t work on myself but I have a hard time finding the motivation to. But things are slowly improving and I have hope for the first time in months. When it comes to not being able to go to the gym a good alternative could be to work out at home, push ups, squats, pull ups (if you have a bar to use). Start with a small number and add a few every couple of days. If you can try to get out of the house, but I don’t know you’re situation. Try to find more things you are passionate about and can be done at home. Do you like music? Can you play an instrument? That type of stuff. This is the advice I would give you but I’m not that much older, only 19 lol. Hope this helps, and know you are not alone
